searchText: that's my understanding as well interesting note on the number of roots 👍 my issue with all this is that I was prototyping the scheme using SECP256K1 because I have no Java implementation of Bandersnatch, but the field order for SECP256K1 does not match that condition I have other things to build before getting there, but I guess I'll have to implement the curve myself — I'm not exactly sure how involved that is (or isn't) this is a good paper on Lattice based cryptography which i am learning about. https://eprint.iacr.org/2015/938.pdf Also a math professor at my university has written this very amazing C++ library for computing combinatorial objects. I have used it exhaustively generate irreducible polynomials in certain Galois Fields, but it also can used to for elliptic curve fields and many more abstract operations. https://github.com/abetten/orbiter
